key_exclusions: same calendar day only — window resets at midnight
credit issued as TrueBlue credit, not cash refund
policy_text_full: JetBlue offers a $50 future TrueBlue credit if the fare drops by $5 or more on the same calendar day as purchase. The window is the tightest in the industry — it resets at midnight, not 24 hours from booking. Award bookings are excluded.
policy_text_relevant_clause: If the fare drops by $5 or more on the same calendar day as purchase, JetBlue issues a $50 TrueBlue credit; the window expires at midnight.
